'''Vlemoth Station''' was an [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform/Legends|orbital gun platform]] constructed by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to guard the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]] against an attack from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Later grounded on the planet's surface, the former [[Orbital gun platform|gun platform]] was reinvented as an independent [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and administration center for the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] industrialists who developed Vlemoth Port and oversaw its commercial trade.

==Description==
Measuring one thousand twenty-seven [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height, Vlemoth Station was originally designed by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] as an [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform/Legends|orbital gun platform]], built in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]]. The [[Space station/Legends|station]] was later grounded on the planet's surface, where it towered over the surrounding landscape like a [[Jade/Legends|jade]]-[[Color/Legends|colored]] pillar, held up by an array of cables, supports, and emergency [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] braces.<ref name="FLT" />

Now functioning as a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the top levels of Vlemoth Station were converted into a number of [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] rooms, shops, and [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], while the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] decks were transformed into a suite of offices for the station's [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] overseers. From here, the Muuns regulated the planet's commerce, collecting rent, fees, and taxes. The thirty decks below hosted several wide [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] with walled-off bays and [[Magnetic field/Legends|mag-shielded]] hangar doors, each capable of holding a dozen [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] and a large amount of cargo. Freight and passenger [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] positioned on either side of the hangar bays provided transit between the stations various levels. Located at the base of Vlemoth Station were the maneuvering decks, housing massive torsion hydraulics used to turn the upper sections of the tower.<ref name="FLT" />

Vlemoth Station was overseen by station control, while it's numerous hangar bays were monitored by hangar control. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] that sought to land at the station were charged a fee of fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and the process of checking in and landing at the station took close to an hour on average. The station also maintained its own force of [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]], capable of intervening in conflicts within Vlemoth Station, and arresting those involved.<ref name="FLT" />

==History==
After the Muun owners of Vlemoth Port established the manufacturing [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sanshur Flats]], they decided to construct an [[orbital gun platform]] over the planet to protect their holdings from an attack by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Eventually, the platform was grounded, brought down to the planet's surface where it was reinvented as an independent spaceport known as Vlemoth Station. The planet's Muun overseers took up residence at the station's peak, where they handled all of Vlemoth Port's interplanetary trade from the office in the tower's converted upper levels.<ref name="FLT" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], operatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] traveled to Vlemoth Port seeking the aid of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] living in the settlement of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]]. Landing in Vlemoth Station's hangar 9, the rebel agents rode one of the stations turbolifts down to hangar 13 where they met with their Mandalorian contact, [[Kad Solus/Legends|Kad Solus]]. Before they could leave, Solus and the rebels came under attack by a group of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] and [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in the employ of [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]], who had put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Solus. The rebel operatives fought off the mercenaries alongside Solus, and subsequently departed Vlemoth Station aboard [[Dikutruni|his ship]] for the Mandalorian settlement of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]].<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vlemoth Station was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Age of Rebellion'']] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published [[December 8]], [[2016]].
